The two are related, but a plan, a sending action and a receipt cannot automatically prove that all the work is done.

O*NET includes driving, observation, dispatch communication, passenger information and shift reporting; Chinese posts may combine patrol and service tasks. A single post description cannot be used to claim that driver duties are identical nationwide.

Organisation and location | Urban rail operating units and the corresponding routes, vehicles and posts. Subway and streetcar environments may differ, and the actual workplace, vehicle type and work scope are checked with the unit.

Materials and tools | Post rules, crew plans, records and work communication serve the actual tasks. Touching vehicles and operating systems requires formal qualification and authority, and consumer simulation or text tools provide no operating authorisation.

Organisation | Driving, dispatch, vehicle maintenance and passenger service each carry responsibility. Shanghai multi-duty crew members include patrol, service and driving-related tasks, which does not mean that every unit adopts the same post integration.

Scheduling and load | The Shanghai, Beijing and MTR samples already read all mention rotating or shift work. Check reporting times, rest arrangements, locations and the allowance scope; personal preference or an assumed uniform schedule cannot replace the post conditions.

Team communication | Communicate the actual situation with the specified supervisor and dispatch, and record the information source, status and items awaiting confirmation. A reporting error can affect later understanding, and AI must not add operating conclusions on its own.

Review and responsibility | Key posts in China require training, assessment and background screening, and drivers lawfully obtain admission qualifications and take regular psychological tests. Occupational exploration, personality questionnaires or paper exercises are not treated as formal assessment.

Quality requirements | Compliance, sustained attention, accurate information, timely collaboration and clear responsibility. The paper work here only observes checking and expression; it does not test train operating quality, reaction ability or accident probability.

values: F1 | Five complete inputs and eight judgments

All original fiction, paper material organising only, with no train, station, passenger or traffic command. S1 organising plan: started 08:00, ended 10:00, planned 120 minutes. description.text: Subway and streetcar operators drive rail public transport to carry passengers and, as the post requires, observe the operating environment, communicate with dispatch, provide passenger information and leave shift records. Safety, rule-following and accurate reporting matter more than simply liking trains. On this page the United States corresponds to 53-4041, while Chinese admission, operating unit assessment and route tasks are checked separately, and an automatic operation system is not generative AI.
